players.name: Lee Bowyer
players.note: His peak by a distance: ever-present, nine goals, and the driving force of a Champions League semi-finalist at 23. Nine points above the 1996/97 anchor across four seasons of real improvement.

players.name: Mark Viduka
players.note: Seventeen league goals and a Champions League semi-final; a genuinely complete centre-forward - touch, strength, finishing - a rung below elite for consistency rather than quality.

players.name: Olivier Dacourt
players.note: His best English season: a first-choice midfielder in a Champions League semi-final side and the one who made it function defensively.

players.name: Dominic Matteo
players.note: A Champions League semi-final season and comfortable at centre-back in it; the best football of his career.

players.name: Ian Harte
players.note: Seven goals and six assists from left-back in a Champions League semi-final side; an outstanding deliverer, always vulnerable defensively.

players.name: Alan Smith
players.note: Eleven league goals at nineteen in a Champions League semi-final side.

players.name: Rio Ferdinand
players.note: A world record fee for a defender in November 2000; the same footballer at West Ham and Leeds, which is the point.

players.name: Nigel Martyn
players.note: Twenty-three starts: shared the Champions League season with Paul Robinson rather than lost form.

players.name: Lucas Radebe
players.note: Nineteen starts; knee trouble began to interrupt him.

players.name: Jonathan Woodgate
players.note: Fourteen starts across a season disrupted by the assault trial; the football, when he played it, was that of 1999/00.

players.name: Harry Kewell
players.note: Twelve starts — injury rather than a fall in level.

players.name: Michael Bridges
players.note: Started the season as the player who scored 19 the year before, then suffered the ankle injury in October that effectively ended his career at 21.

players.name: Jacob Burns
players.note: An Australia international holding midfielder of second-tier standard.

players.name: Danny Hay
players.note: A New Zealand international who was never near the standard of the side he was in.
